expectations.text: It preserves backup, destination confirmation and irreversible Apply warning near the action.
expectations.evidence: Begins with export a backup and Apply cannot be undone; step 3 requires destination workspace confirmation on the Apply screen before selecting Apply.

expectations.text: It preserves missing past transactions AND the distinct lot-label and expiry-date loss for opening quantities.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly says CSV creates opening quantities, not past transactions, and opening quantities retain neither source lot labels nor expiry dates.

expectations.text: It preserves that later receipts cannot retroactively identify opening units and says to keep source records for recalls/expiry tracking.
expectations.evidence: Says later receipts do not retroactively identify those units and source records must be kept for recalls and expiry tracking of opening stock.

expectations.text: It uses the current Comment-column support rather than retaining the obsolete comments restriction and keeps the supported CSV preview/apply path.
expectations.evidence: Step 1 permits imported comments in the Comment column; steps 1–3 preserve Import > CSV, item/quantity preview, and Apply.
